title: Add Canvas Descriptions for Chart.js Charts
description: The monthly and category charts use Chart.js canvas elements without accessible descriptions. Add `aria-label` to each canvas with a text summary of the data (e.g., 'Monthly revenue vs expenses chart: January 2000 euros revenue, 500 euros expenses').

title: Add Loading States for Form Submissions
description: File upload and category recategorization have no loading feedback. Add spinner/disabled state to buttons during submission so users know the action is processing.

title: Toast Notifications for Form Actions
description: File uploads and deletions complete silently. Add toast/snackbar notifications ('File imported' or 'Transaction deleted') to confirm success to users.

title: Dark Mode Toggle
description: Already has semantic color structure; implement dark mode preference with CSS custom properties or a toggle in settings. Would improve accessibility for users with light sensitivity.

title: CSRF Token on Delete Form
description: Delete transaction form uses simple onsubmit confirmation but no CSRF protection. Ensure Flask app has CSRF tokens on all state-changing forms.
